# problem 1

$$\begin{aligned}
Prior \ :& \ \theta \sim Beta(a,b) \\
Sampling \ model \ :& \ y|\theta \sim  Binomial(n,\theta) \\
Posterior \ :& \ \theta|y \sim Beta(a+y, \  b-n+y)
\end{aligned}$$

```{r}

x <- seq(0,1,length.out = 10000)
y11 <- dunif(x)
y12 <- dbeta(x,2,5)
m1 <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(x,y11))+
  geom_line(aes(x,y12))+
  theme_bw()

y21 <- dbeta(x,3,2)
y22 <- dbeta(x,4,6)

m2 <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(x,y21))+
  geom_line(aes(x,y22))+
  theme_bw()

y31 <- dbeta(x,1,1)
y32 <- dbeta(x,21,81)


m3 <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(x,y31))+
  geom_line(aes(x,y32))+
  theme_bw()

y41 <- dbeta(x,3,2)
y42 <- dbeta(x,23,82)

m4 <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(x,y41))+
  geom_line(aes(x,y42))+
  theme_bw()

grid.arrange(m1,m2,m3,m4,nrow =2)
```

# problem 2

Sensitivity analysis:\newline Parameters of beta distribution a and b in terms of $\theta_0 = \frac{a}{a+b}$ and $\eta_{0} = a+b$, so that $a = \theta_{0}\eta_0$ and $b = (1-\theta_0)\eta_0$. For each $\theta_0 \in \{0.1, \ 0.2, \ldots, \ 0.9 \}$ and $\eta_0 \in \{1, \ 2,\ 8 ,\ 16, \ 32 \}$.\newline

Find: \newline
1. Corresponding a, b values.\newline 
2. $Pr(\theta >0.5 \ |\sum Y_{i} = 57 )$

```{r}
theta_not  <- seq(.1,.9,by =.1)
eta_not    <- c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)

data <- tibble( theta = theta_not)

data <- data %>% 
  expand_grid(tibble(eta = eta_not))


data <- data%>%
  mutate(density =  pbeta(.5,theta*eta+57,eta*(1-theta)-57+100,
                          lower.tail = FALSE ),
         a = theta*eta,
         b = eta*(1-theta))



ggplot(data =data)+
  geom_contour(
    aes(y= theta, x = eta,
                   z = density, 
        color = after_stat(level)))+
  labs(y = expression(theta),
       x = expression(eta))+
  theme_minimal()
```
